name: sessions_list
title: List conversations
description: List DeepSeek Harness conversations with id, title, working directory, running state and token usage. Call this first to discover the sessionId to read or prompt.

name: session_read
title: Read conversation history
description: Read durable history of one conversation (user, assistant and tool messages). Use beforeSeq to page further back.

beforeSeq.description: Only return events before this sequence number.

name: session_send
title: Send a message into a conversation
description: Send a user message into an existing conversation. The message joins the live chat a human sees and starts a model turn. mode=queue waits for the current turn, mode=steer interrupts into it.

name: session_create
title: Open a new conversation
description: Open a new blank conversation in the Harness and return its id. Combine with session_send to start work in a fresh chat.

cwd.description: Absolute directory the conversation works in.

agentPreset.description: Agent preset name. Omit for the configured default.

name: session_search
title: Search conversations
description: Full-text search across conversations. Works only when the Harness has the session-query index enabled; otherwise the Host reports that search is disabled.

name: session_inspect
title: Inspect one conversation
description: Vitals of one conversation: title, run state, token usage, context pressure, pending queue, selected model and goal. Cheaper than reading history when you only need its state.

name: session_rename
title: Rename a conversation
description: Set the title of one conversation. Returns the normalized title and the event position that committed it.

name: session_fork
title: Fork a conversation
description: Copy a conversation prefix into a new conversation and return its id. Omit atSeq to fork at the latest completed turn — useful to branch off an alternative approach without disturbing the original.

atSeq.description: Exact inclusive source event seq to cut at.

name: session_cancel
title: Stop a running turn
description: Ask the Host to cancel the turn a conversation is currently running. Pending inbox work is retained, so a queued message is not lost.

name: models_list
title: List available models
description: Every model route this harness can currently reach, grouped by provider, with the reasoning efforts each accepts and the deployment default. Call before session_select_model.

name: session_select_model
title: Choose the model for a conversation
description: Pin one provider/model route (and optional reasoning effort) to a conversation. Use models_list first: an unavailable pair is rejected with session/model-unavailable.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort id the route accepts.
